_about: TEMPLATE for your own gold set of REAL vendors. Copy to data/gold_set_real.json and fill it by hand: open each vendor's trust centre, privacy policy, sub-processor list and pricing page yourself, and record the URL and the date you checked. Do not let the agent fill this file — then you would be grading the agent with its own answers. Aim for 10 vendors x 8 fields. Pick a mix: 3 that should clearly pass, 3 that should clearly fail at least one blocker, 4 that are messy (claims without evidence, regions 'coming soon', training opt-outs).

how_to_fill.security_certifications: List each certification as {name, status, date, valid_until, issuer}. name must be one of: 'SOC 2 Type II', 'SOC 2 Type I', 'SOC 2' (type not stated), 'ISO 27001'. status: certified | in_progress | planned. Record evidence_level: documented (report, certificate, or trust-centre entry that links to it) or claimed (marketing text only).
how_to_fill.data_regions: {available: [...], planned: [...]} using country or region names as the vendor writes them. 'India' must appear in available for DP-3.1 to pass.
how_to_fill.subprocessors: List of {name, purpose, category, country}. category: hosting | model_provider | email | analytics | support | other. null if the vendor publishes no list.
how_to_fill.data_retention: {default_days, deletion_on_request_days} as integers; null when the vendor does not say.
how_to_fill.security_incidents: List of {date, summary, severity (major|minor), postmortem_published, postmortem_url} for the last 24 months; [] if none found; null if you could not establish it.
